method: Reviewed Anthropic Demystifying evals for AI agents and the registered OpenAI Evaluation best-practices resource. Executed the lesson Python fence under Python 3.10. The offline verifier checks metric/documentation boundaries, candidate review branches, terminal-task denominators, zero-denominator and missing-usage handling, synthetic output and exact stdout; no provider or external-network calls.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 operational schedule and owner table are constructed examples, not measured team workload or a generally recommended cadence.
The code fixtures are synthetic and do not validate production trace collection, privacy controls, graders, monitoring, billing, release rollout, or holdout governance.
Historical production metrics and outcomes cannot be independently reproduced because underlying traces, task definitions, model snapshots and scorers are not retained in this worktree.
